title: Accounts — {{tool}}
isolationIsolated: Isolated per session via separate config directory / env vars; concurrent sessions can use different accounts
isolationHostActive: Host-active OAuth credentials; one OAuth account is active globally per host
autoFailoverTool: Automatically switch to a backup account on usage limit
envOverrideWarn: Environment override active: {{env}} (may override tool credentials)
capturePrompt: New account label (leave empty to auto-name; always saves as a new profile)
kiroLoginHint: In-app sign-in uses a Builder ID device code. To sign in with Google, GitHub or your organization (Identity Center), run kiro-cli login in a terminal, then click “Capture Current Login as New”.
codebuddyLoginHint: CodeBuddy has no separate sign-in command: run codebuddy in a terminal, sign in with /login, then click “Capture Current Login as New”. The CodeBuddy IDE extension shares this login, so switching accounts here switches the extension's account too.
loginDeviceAuth: Device Auth (works on headless / remote hosts)
noAccounts: No accounts configured yet. Capture the native login, sign in via CLI, or add an API Key profile.
deleteConfirm: Delete account "{{label}}"? Its stored credentials will be removed.
capturedToast: Saved current login as new account "{{label}}"
fieldLabelCursorPlaceholder: Leave empty to auto-name by account email
cursorApiKeyHint: Validates the key and fetches email/plan on save; runs with in-memory credentials so local OAuth login is never overwritten.
fieldExtraEnv: Extra Env Vars (one KEY=VALUE per line, optional)
fieldAllowFailover: Allow auto failover to this account on usage limit (off by default for API Key)
importPlaceholder: Paste a credential bundle JSON exported from another host, or load a file…
exportTitle: Exported Credential Bundle (contains secrets — keep safe)
loginSucceeded: Sign-in succeeded and account was saved
loginInputPlaceholder: Paste callback URL, auth code, or prompt response…
actualProviderLine: Codex uses the provider "{{provider}}" from config.toml: {{url}}
actualProviderLineNoUrl: Codex uses the provider "{{provider}}" from config.toml
actualKeyFromEnv: The API key comes from the environment variable {{env}}
actualKeyMissing: The environment variable {{env}} isn't set, so Codex has no API key and requests will fail
actualOpenaiAuthLine: Requests send the login in ~/.codex/auth.json to this provider
actualOauthUnused: ~/.codex/auth.json has a ChatGPT login, but it isn't being used
savedAsOauth: This account is saved as an OAuth account
codexMismatchWarn: This account is saved as a ChatGPT login ({{email}}), but its config.toml selects the provider "{{provider}}": requests go to that provider, this login isn't used, and the plan's quota doesn't apply.
convertToApiKeyConfirm: Turn "{{label}}" into an API key account for the provider {{provider}}: the current value of {{env}} is saved as its key and it keeps using that provider. The ChatGPT login is backed up so you can switch back later.
convertToOauthConfirm: Stop "{{label}}" from using the provider {{provider}}: model_provider is removed from its config.toml, and sessions started afterwards use the ChatGPT login and its plan's quota.
